lines.en: I scurry along, claws digging in.
I hug the wall as I chase you.
My tail whips from side to side.
One brick is a long jump for me.
I run behind the bigger ones.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子往前冲。
lines.en: I charge over my own shadow.
I giggle as I run.

lines.zh: 我跑过的地方土都翻了。
lines.en: The dirt turns over wherever I run.
I circle you looking for a gap.
My claw prints trail behind me.
I am not fast, but there are many of me.

lines.zh: 我从土里钻出半个身子。
lines.en: I pull half my body out of the dirt.
I dig at the dirt by my feet.
I crouch, hoping you have not seen me.
I gnaw a muddy stone.
My ears keep twitching.
I count my pack: one, two, three.
I scratch my belly.
There is a bug in the dirt; I dig it out.

lines.zh: 我对着自己的爪子吹气。
lines.en: I blow on my own claws.
I plop down on a mound of dirt.
I look up at the summoner's hand.
You crouch, so I look up.
I aim at the laces on your boots.
Your boots are muddy, like mine.
I tilt my head, thinking about biting your fingers.
You are much taller than the doorframe.
I circle around your heels.
You blink once; I copy you.
I bare my teeth; you bare yours.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里有东西在响。
lines.en: Something is rattling in your pocket.

lines.zh: 仰头看你，我脖子快断了。
lines.en: Looking up at you breaks my neck.

lines.zh: 尾巴挨了一下，我缩成一团。
lines.en: My tail takes a hit and I curl into a ball.
I squeal and curl up.
That knocked me flying.
I dig at the ground in pain.
The horn on my head got knocked crooked.
I push myself up, legs trembling.
Not the head, not the head.
I burrow halfway down.

lines.zh: 血滴在土上，马上渗进去。
lines.en: Blood drips onto the dirt and soaks in.
I will be back.
Food? Drop it here, quickly.
The smell of meat crawled up my nose.

lines.zh: 你把面包举那么高做什么。
lines.en: Why hold the bread so high.
I cannot reach; lower it.
I am not picky; I eat whatever falls.
Luring me with food? It works a little.
My teeth are small but eager.

lines.zh: 那块肉上有灰，我不介意。
lines.en: That meat is dusty; I do not mind.
Give it to me and I will spare your ankle.
I jump for your hand.
Your sole nearly flattened me.
Your bump sent me rolling.

lines.zh: 我的爪子勾住你的裤脚。
lines.en: My claws snag your trouser leg.
Do not crowd; I have not squeezed through.
I bounce off your leg.
You kick me away; I come back.
I stepped on your instep.
My horn nudged you.
We collide, both covered in dirt.
Make a gap; I want through.
Our kind does not bother with that.
I only know the summoner's scent.

lines.zh: 挤在一起睡就算亲近了。
lines.en: Sleeping in a pile counts as closeness.
Stop asking; I have a hole to dig.

lines.zh: 同伴够多了，打起来都挤。
lines.en: There are enough of us; fights get crowded.
I scratch my head, uncomprehending.

lines.zh: 土里出生的，没那么多讲究。
lines.en: Born of dirt, no such formalities.

lines.zh: 我只想抢到最大的那块肉。
lines.en: I only want the biggest piece of meat.

lines.zh: 谁跟我分洞，谁就是我朋友。
lines.en: Whoever shares my burrow is my friend.

lines.zh: 我打了个滚，躲开这个问题。
lines.en: I roll away from the question.

lines.zh: 我扒出一颗亮晶晶的石子。
lines.en: I dig out a shiny little pebble.
This bone is mine.
I stuff the thing into my cheek.
You drop so many things.
I drag a scrap of cloth away.
The iron scrap is too heavy to drag.
I pick up a stick as a weapon.
Can this be eaten?
I carry the fruit into my burrow.
Hide it first, eat later.
Found you; do not run.
The summoner pointed at you.
I smell the sweat on your feet.
You crushed our burrow.
Everyone, go for him now.
I see your ankles.
You shrink into the corner; even better.
I found you first.
You glow; far too obvious.
I bite down on your shadow.
This one is mine.
I poke my head out and stare.
Do not look for the others; look at me.
You run; we chase.

lines.zh: 我从石头缝里看见你停下。
lines.en: I saw you stop through a gap in the rocks.
I lie low in the dirt, hind legs tense.
I slip around behind you.
When you turn, I bite.

lines.zh: 我抓地上的土，扬你眼睛。
lines.en: I fling dirt at your eyes.
I count to three, then my claws move.
My pack is on the other side.
Your heel is lifting.
I crawl low and silent.
Look at me, not at him.
I grind my teeth, waiting for you to bend.
Step by step, closer.
One flick of my tail and I move.
You shuffle back; I shuffle forward.
These teeth have not bitten iron yet.

lines.zh: 我学着同伴的样子包过去。
lines.en: I copy my kin and close from the side.

lines.zh: 我用爪子刨土，把路堵窄。
lines.en: I dig at the dirt and narrow your path.

lines.zh: 你举火把，我就往暗处退。
lines.en: You raise the torch; I slide into the dark.

lines.zh: 我先咬你的鞋跟，再咬脚踝。
lines.en: I snap at your heel first, then your ankle.
I sink my teeth into your calf.
My claws rake your shin.
I leap and swipe at your hand.
This bite did not go through.
I hang from your trouser leg.
I butt you with the horn on my head.
You throw me off; I pounce again.
I bite your finger and taste blood.
The three of us attack together.
I swipe for your eyes and miss.
That only broke the skin.

lines.zh: 我咬着不放，直到被甩开。
lines.en: I hold on until shaken loose.
Your boots are too hard.
I pant, but I want another go.

lines.zh: 我扑上你的膝弯，挂住了。
lines.en: I leap onto the back of your knee and hold.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在你护腕的缝里。
lines.en: This bite lands in the seam of your bracer.
A claw pushes out of the dirt.
I claw my way out of the ground.

lines.zh: 召唤师跺了跺脚，我就来了。
lines.en: The summoner stamped a foot, and here I am.
I shake the mud off.
So many people here.
You are the first thing I saw.
The soil is loose and easy to dig.
I crawl out and look around.
My pack is still below.
I lick the mud off my claws.
There is work to do today.
I squeeze out through a crack.
Who woke me up.
I grin with dirt-covered teeth.
My tail caught fire.
I fell into my own burrow.
Water floods the burrow; I choke.
The blast buried me in dirt.
An arrow pins me to the ground.
Magic holds me still.
Hunger makes me chew my own claws.
Lightning leaves me smoking.
In the void there is no dirt to grab.
